subject: Pegasus Health — privacy controls intake & evidence roadmap
messages:
From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@pegasushealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: procure@pegasushealth.com, t.becker@pegasushealth.com
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Security intake & questionnaire kickoff request

Hi Marcus,

Thanks for the intro — Pegasus is ready to kick off the security intake so we can complete our procurement checklist. We have a short SIG questionnaire and a few SOC 2 confirms we need to validate. I attached the initial SIG workbook ("Pegasus_SIG_Initial.xlsx") — it's our baseline.

Would your team be available next week for a 30-minute intake call to walk through controls scoping, evidence owners, and timeboxes? We prefer morning PST. Also let us know who from Redwood will own the evidence items (e.g., logging, backups, encryption at rest).

Cheers,
Lena Ortiz
Procurement Manager | Pegasus Health
Attachments: Pegasus_SIG_Initial.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@pegasushealth.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security intake & questionnaire kickoff request

Hi Lena — thanks for sending this over and for the clear ask. We can definitely run a focused 30-minute intake to triage the SIG and map owners for SOC 2 evidence.

Proposed times (PST):
- Tue 2026-08-24 09:30–10:00
- Tue 2026-08-24 11:00–11:30
- Wed 2026-08-25 08:30–09:00

I've looped in Lauren (Security Compliance) and Grace (Customer Success) who will help own evidence collection. Lauren — is there a preferred packet we should prepare (control matrix + sample artifacts) so we minimize back-and-forth?

Agenda suggestion for the 30-min slot:
1) Confirm questionnaire scope (SIG, CAIQ, SOC 2 subset)
2) Identify evidence owners and expected deliverables
3) Decide on delivery cadence and shared folder / tracker

If you prefer, we can attach a short controls matrix before the call so you can mark which rows you need to see artifacts for.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@pegasushealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Becker <t.becker@pegasushealth.com>, procure@pegasushealth.com
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 08:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security intake & questionnaire kickoff request

Thanks Marcus — Tue 8/24 at 11:00 PST works for us (that's our preferred). I've uploaded our canonical SIG/CAIQ workbook to a shared Drive folder and attached a copy to this email. Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcdPegasusSecurity

A couple of prep notes from our side:
- We care most about data residency (do you allow EU-only processing), encryption keys (who holds them), and retention/retention deletes for PII.
- Can you confirm whether Redwood retains request logs for 90 days by default? If not, what's the retention policy and how would that be adjusted for an enterprise contract?

Attachment: Pegasus_SIG_Initial.xlsx (updated v1)

Lena
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 22 Aug 2026 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Pegasus intake — evidence owners and pre-call notes

Marcus / Grace — quick internal note before the intake:

Pre-call prep (what I'll bring):
- Controls matrix (redwood_controls_matrix.xlsx) with rows for encryption at rest, in transit, key management, logging, backups, RBAC, incident response artifacts
- SOC 2 mapping document that highlights which controls we can provide canned evidence for and which require configuration or customer involvement (e.g., VPC peering configs)

Suggested owners:
- Logging artifacts: Platform Ops (assign later; ask if they can provide sample Kibana export)
- Backups & retention evidence: SRE (we can provide snapshot policy + retention diagrams)
- Encryption/KMS: Security Eng (we can outline our KMS integration and key rotation cadence)

Ask: Marcus — can you confirm whether Pegasus needs EU-only processing for certain datasets? If yes, we should surface Dedicated/Private options in the call.

-lauren
Security Compliance Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>

Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security intake & questionnaire kickoff request

On Tue, Aug 24, 2026 at 11:00 AM PST we met — calendar invite accepted. Per our short sync, attaching the controls matrix we discussed (redwood_controls_matrix.xlsx).

Meeting notes / agenda we covered:
- Scope confirmed: Pegasus will need SIG + CAIQ answers for initial procurement; SOC 2 artifact package to follow after contract.
- Regional requirement: Pegasus clarified only PHI-adjacent datasets need EU processing; they will mark rows in the Drive doc. We flagged Dedicated/Private as an option if they require strict EU-only processing and key custody.
- Retention & logs: Default request logs retention is 90 days; we can extend via contract and Dedicated tenants for longer retention windows.
- Deliverables & owners:
  * Controls matrix (Redwood) — Marcus / Lauren to deliver annotated matrix by 2026-08-27
  * Logging export sample (Platform Ops) — owner: SRE team; expected by 2026-09-03
  * KMS/key rotation documentation (Security Eng) — Lauren to provide by 2026-08-31

Attachments: redwood_controls_matrix.xlsx
Related: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcdPegasusSecurity | HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/pegasus-health

Thanks for the quick call — we'll follow up with the annotated matrix and a short tracker.

Marcus Lin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
